notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Utopia Mycon by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
